verdict.rationale: jo runs on the user's Mac as a native app and has its own isolated cloud machine with its own browser, where it can work overnight. That suggests some agentic operation of a computer environment. However, nothing in the evidence shows it seeing or controlling applications on the user's own computer; its other capabilities come through API integrations such as Linear and GitHub. Missing for 10: documented screen-viewing or GUI control of apps on the user's machine, details of how its browser automation works, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
